name: apply_promo_code_to_cart
description: Applies a promotional/discount code to the authenticated user's cart on Carrefour France. Associates the promo code with a specific facility/store service and sub-basket type (e.g. drive click-and-collect). Returns a success confirmation or an error if the code is invalid or cannot be applied.

code.description: The promotional/discount code to apply to the cart (e.g. 'ETE10').

facilityServiceId.description: The facility/store service ID to associate the promo code with (e.g. '0678-150-7052').

subBasketType.description: The sub-basket type for the cart (e.g. 'drive_clcv' for drive click-and-collect).
